_comment: Era I look per region (world area: Act II Corvane, Act IV Solenne). palette = the 4 inks of the screen filter, darkest to lightest; each must stay in its luminance band (<0.25, <0.5, <0.75, >=0.75) so EraManager's filter maps every sprite the same way. The region's tiles are art/era1/tiles/overworld_<region>.png (TilesetFactory.atlas_path; Corvane's from tools/art/gen_tiles_corvane.py, Solenne's from tools/art/gen_tiles_solenne.py; both read this palette). biome = the look's name, props = what its atlas draws. Regions not listed use the base Ink palette.

corvane.arrive: The ink turns blue here. Corvane dyes everything, even the truth.

solenne.arrive: The ink bleaches here. Solenne burns everything, even the lies. Especially the lies.
